name: Dangerous Collapsing Debris OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-16: A Lie Told to Strangers

stealth.note: (trained) to notice the instability in the surrounding woodwork and precariously balanced masonry.

description: The room initially appears merely dilapidated, but on closer inspection it is positively liable to collapse at any moment.
disable: DC 23 Crafting (untrained) to safely shore up the weaknesses in the masonry by replacing rotten wood with other assorted bric-a-brac, DC 20 Thievery (trained) to carefully place boards and the like to create bridges over structurally weak areas.

offensiveAbilities.name: Collapse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves into the hazardous area

Effect Bricks and broken wood fall on the triggering creature, dealing (2d10+13) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save).
